scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Exact results cover only pure degree-two harmonics on even-dimensional spheres with the balanced sign-chamber region. Region mass decays as dimension increases, so no dimension-uniform unnormalized lower frame bound is asserted. Equivalence to older unstated Johnson-scheme calculations remains possible. Claims and checks are same-model research review only.
title: Balanced-orthant concentration of quadratic spherical harmonics: a complete spectrum and the dimension-twelve switch
